ns2:section.sectionText: Special Instructions: One hour LIVE session each week to discuss main points and complete small group discussions. These occur on Tuesday, 16:00-16:50, 8/26/14 to 12/9/14 via Collaborate (previously Elluminate). Students should have high speed internet connection (preferably not wireless), and a microphone or headset with microphone for course interaction during the LIVE sessions.
